input.answer: I didn't choose anything. I'll ask you, and then the bank. The only lines that sounded safe to me were the ones called "מבטיח תשואה" and the "כספי (שקלי)" ones with 0% מניות and about 4–4.9% over 3 years, but I'm not sure about them. Some of those boxes said "לא דווח" with an orange warning mark.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
stuck.why: Most of the buttons mean nothing to me: 'עוקב s&p 500', 'עוקב מדדי מניות', 'עוקב מדדים - גמיש'. I didn't know which one is the safe one, so I pressed nothing.
Coloured rings with numbers like '101%' and '103%'. How can it be more than everything? I couldn't tell the two colours apart properly either.
Every company has 15–20 rows, each with eight numbers. It is all on a black screen. After four screens my eyes hurt and I stopped. I never reached the bottom.

stuck.where: Rows 'ביטוח מבטחת תשואה 4.5%' / '5.5%' (מיטב) and 'גמולה מבטיחת תשואה' (הפניקס)
stuck.why: That sounded exactly like what I want, a promised return. But next to it there is 'לא דווח' and 'עוד לא דווח' with an orange warning mark. At הפניקס the fee is '2%', which is high. I didn't understand whether that is good or bad.

A huge table with very many numbers on every row (fees, exposure, returns, money). It made me anxious, and I couldn't tell what is safe.
English words and terms I don't know right at the start: 's&p 500', 'עוקב מדדי מניות', 'מט"ח'. It feels like it isn't for people like me.
